subject: Evidence request: Cumulus Health data lifecycle sampling & short-term log extension
messages:
From: Sara Burns <sara.burns@cumulushealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: security@cumulushealth.com
Date: Tue, 16 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: Cumulus Health data lifecycle sampling & short-term log extension

Hi Vanessa / Neha —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Cumulus is moving into our SIG/CAIQ review and we need a handful of artifacts to close our operational risk items. Specifically: 

- A small, redacted sample showing how session/request logs are retained and deleted for tenant-scoped requests (example: tenant ID CUM-1974).
- The retention matrix you maintain (TTL by data class and any tenant exceptions).
- An example deletion certificate or audit entry showing a completed deletion cycle.

In parallel, our security team is asking whether Redwood can temporarily retain request-level logs for Cumulus for up to 90 days (our internal audit window) while we onboard. Our standard SIG baseline is 30 days. If a short-term variance is required, we need the controls/evidence you will apply (scoped hold, access restrictions, attestations).

I've attached the updated SIG questionnaire (Cumulus-SIG-Questionnaire.xlsx) with the relevant fields highlighted. Can you confirm what you can provide and an ETA? We aim to close the security review by Friday, Aug 19.

Thanks —
Sara Burns
Director, InfoSec Programs
Cumulus Health
sara.burns@cumulushealth.com
(415) 555-2198


From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Sara Burns <sara.burns@cumulushealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Aug 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: Cumulus Health data lifecycle sampling & short-term log extension

Sara —

Appreciate the clear asks and the highlighted questionnaire. Quick summary of what we can deliver this week and next steps: 

1) Artifacts we will provide by EOD Thu (Aug 18):
   - Tenant-scoped retention matrix (retention-matrix.pdf) showing TTLs for ephemeral session logs, request logs, audit logs, and backup windows.
   - Redacted log sample (single-session request + KV cache entries) for tenant CUM-1974 with PII/PHI fields masked.
   - Example deletion audit entry and the playbook we run to execute and verify deletion.

2) Short-term log retention variance:
   - We can support a scoped 90-day retention for CUM-1974 for a one-time transitional period (90 days) under a documented addendum. Controls we will apply:
     * Tenant-scoped preservation hold with access limited to the security team (RBAC in the console).
     * Encrypted-at-rest with customer tenant key scoped to the preserved objects.
     * Isolation: retained artifacts moved to a retention-only bucket with immutability flag for the period.
     * Audit entries and attestation exported as a signed artifact at the end of the retention window.

3) Requirements from Cumulus:
   - Signed addendum or PO referencing the one-time retention variance (we can supply DocuSign template).
   - Confirmation of the tenant IDs and any sub-tenants to include.

Attachments: retention-matrix.pdf (redacted), and we'll assemble a SIG evidence pack (zip) for delivery.

If that plan works, I'll have Neha coordinate the redacted samples and Jonas will provide the crypto/audit notes for the attestation. Aditya — can your team draft the addendum language we usually use for short-term retention variances?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Customer Security Liaison
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com


From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: Sara Burns <sara.burns@cumulushealth.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Aug 2028 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: Cumulus Health data lifecycle sampling & short-term log extension

Sara / Vanessa —

Thanks for the plan. From a contracts perspective we'll need a short addendum that:

- Defines the scope (tenant CUM-1974 only), duration (90 days), and the exact data classes included (request logs, session traces).
- Limits Redwood's liability and confirms the customer-requested exception does not alter the baseline SLA for other tenants.
- Requires an authorized signatory and references the main services agreement (I'll pull the SOW/contract id once you confirm).

I'll prepare a DocuSign-ready addendum and send a link. For expedited processing, include a PO number in the response; otherwise we can proceed on a signed addendum.

Link (draft addendum): https://www.docusign.com/exec/1234-ccum-addendum

Aditya Rao
Senior Counsel, Business Affairs
Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com


From: Sara Burns <sara.burns@cumulushealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: security@cumulushealth.com
Date: Thu, 18 Aug 2028 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: Cumulus Health data lifecycle sampling & short-term log extension

Vanessa / Aditya —

This looks good. We confirm tenant CUM-1974 and sub-tenant CUM-1974-analytics for the temporary variance. We will route the DocuSign addendum to procurement today; PO #CH-4231 will be included if the addendum is accepted.

Deliverables requested: redacted sample, the retention-matrix.pdf, and the signed attestation template (signed by Redwood at the end of the 90-day window). Given our audit schedule, please prioritize the redacted sample and the deletion-audit example — those will unblock the SIG review.

Also, can you confirm who will have access to retained logs during the variance (names or roles)? Our security team wants a minimal list.

Thanks,
Sara
